scripts.build: pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/contracts build && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/control-plane build && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/research-ui build && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/web build
scripts.prepare:engine-pyo3: uv run --project services/quant-domain --frozen maturin develop --manifest-path crates/quant-engine/Cargo.toml --features python
scripts.start:m4: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:engine-pyo3 && node scripts/run-m4-local.mjs
scripts.test:domain: PYTHONPATH=services/quant-domain/src uv run --project services/quant-domain --frozen python -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest discover -s services/quant-domain/test -p 'test_*.py' -v
scripts.test:domain:base: PYTHONPATH=services/quant-domain/src uv run --project services/quant-domain --frozen python -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest discover -s services/quant-domain/test -p 'test_m[12]*.py' -v
scripts.test:engine: cargo test --manifest-path crates/quant-engine/Cargo.toml --locked --offline && cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/quant-engine/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path crates/quant-engine/Cargo.toml --locked --offline --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test:engine-pyo3: uv run --project services/quant-domain --frozen maturin develop --manifest-path crates/quant-engine/Cargo.toml --features python && PYTHONPATH=services/quant-domain/src uv run --project services/quant-domain --frozen python -W error -m unittest discover -s crates/quant-engine/tests -p 'test_python_binding.py' -v
scripts.test:golden: uv run --project services/quant-domain --frozen python scripts/verify-golden-backtest.py fixtures/backtests/m0-long-short-v1.json
scripts.test:m3-revisions: pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/contracts build && node --test packages/contracts/test/m3_revision_contracts.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/control-plane build && node --test apps/control-plane/test/m3-revision-tools.test.mjs && PYTHONPATH=services/quant-domain/src:services/quant-domain/test uv run --project services/quant-domain --frozen python -W error -m unittest test_m3_git_workspace test_m3_revisions test_m3_http test_m3_formal_runs
scripts.test:m4: pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/contracts test && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/control-plane test && PYTHONPATH=services/quant-domain/src:services/quant-domain/test uv run --project services/quant-domain --frozen python -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest test_m4_read_models test_m4_worker && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/research-ui build && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/web build && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/web test:e2e
scripts.test:m5-domain: PYTHONPATH=services/quant-domain/src:services/quant-domain/test uv run --project services/quant-domain --frozen python -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest test_m3_formal_runs.M3FormalRunDomainTest.test_merge_candidate_is_two_parent_immutable_and_moves_no_head test_m3_formal_runs.M3FormalRunDomainTest.test_formal_run_persists_a_hash_bound_manifest_without_recalculation test_m3_formal_runs.M3FormalRunDomainTest.test_same_runspec_rerun_has_a_new_run_identity_and_same_calculation_hash test_m3_formal_runs.M3FormalRunDomainTest.test_strategy_output_is_authoritative_for_the_resolved_engine_input test_m4_read_models.M4ReadModelsHttpTest.test_project_and_activity_lists_are_stable_read_models test_m4_read_models.M4ReadModelsHttpTest.test_project_artifact_metadata_and_content_are_readable test_m4_read_models.M4ReadModelsHttpTest.test_completed_formal_run_list_and_detail_are_read_only_artifact_views test_m4_read_models.M4ReadModelsHttpTest.test_failed_formal_run_detail_has_no_result_artifacts test_m4_worker.M4WorkerProcessTest.test_worker_process_claims_formal_job_and_stops_cleanly test_m4_worker.M4WorkerProcessTest.test_two_workers_never_claim_two_formal_runs_concurrently test_m5_diagnostics test_m5_forward_replay test_m5_forward_test test_m5_lifecycle test_m5_project_archive -v
scripts.test:m5-ui: pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/research-ui build && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/web build && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/web exec playwright test e2e/m4-vertical.spec.ts
scripts.test:m6-domain: PYTHONPATH=services/quant-domain/src:services/quant-domain/test uv run --project services/quant-domain --frozen python -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest test_m3_revisions.M3RevisionDomainTest.test_two_variants_keep_independent_child_revisions_and_compare test_m3_formal_runs.M3FormalRunDomainTest.test_two_validated_candidates_race_and_only_one_cas_promote_wins -v
scripts.test:m6-browser: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:engine-pyo3 && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/web exec playwright test e2e/m4-live.spec.ts
scripts.test:m7-domain: PYTHONPATH=services/quant-domain/src:services/quant-domain/test uv run --project services/quant-domain --frozen python -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest test_m7_data_import test_m7_data_snapshot_http test_m5_forward_replay test_m5_project_archive test_m1_domain test_m3_formal_runs -v
scripts.test:m7-ui: pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/research-ui build && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/web build && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/web exec playwright test e2e/m7-data-import.spec.ts
scripts.test:m8-domain: PYTHONPATH=services/quant-domain/src:services/quant-domain/test uv run --project services/quant-domain --frozen python -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest test_m8_strategy_library test_m8_strategy_workbench test_m8_portfolio_formal -v
scripts.test:m8-ui: pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/research-ui build && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/web build && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/web exec playwright test e2e/m8-strategy-workbench.spec.ts
scripts.test:m9-domain: PYTHONPATH=services/quant-domain/src:services/quant-domain/test uv run --project services/quant-domain --frozen python -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest test_m9_run_report test_m9_run_report_domain test_m9_six_strategy_reports.M9SixStrategyReportsTest -v
scripts.test:m9-ui: pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/research-ui build && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/web build && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/web exec playwright test e2e/m9-run-report.spec.ts
scripts.test:m10:checks: node scripts/check-m10-locks.mjs && node scripts/check-m10-licenses.mjs && node scripts/check-m10-config.mjs
scripts.test:m10-browser: pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/control-plane build && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/research-ui build && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/web build && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/web exec playwright test e2e/m10-total.spec.ts --reporter=line
scripts.validate:m0: pnpm run check:bootstrap && pnpm run check:data-root && pnpm run test:contracts && pnpm run test:golden
scripts.validate:m1: pnpm run validate:m0 && pnpm run test:control-plane && pnpm run test:domain:base
scripts.validate:m3-revisions: pnpm run validate:m2 && pnpm run test:m3-revisions
scripts.validate:m3: pnpm run validate:m2 && pnpm run test:engine && pnpm run test:engine-pyo3 && pnpm run test:domain && pnpm run test:m3-revisions
scripts.validate:m4: pnpm run validate:m3 && pnpm run test:m4
scripts.validate:m5: pnpm run check:bootstrap && pnpm run check:data-root && pnpm run test:contracts && pnpm run test:engine && pnpm run test:engine-pyo3 && pnpm run test:m5-domain && pnpm run test:m5-control-plane && pnpm run test:m5-ui
scripts.validate:m6: pnpm run validate:m5 && pnpm run test:m6-domain && pnpm run test:m6-session && pnpm run test:m6-browser

scripts.validate:m9: pnpm run validate:m8 && pnpm run test:m9-contracts && pnpm run test:m9-domain && pnpm run test:m9-control-plane && pnpm run test:m9-ui
